title: EventEnvelope
description: One durable outbox event, appended inside the writing transaction. A module owns its payload schema but never the envelope fields.

event_type.description: Dotted and owned by the emitting module, e.g. assessment.result_published.

aggregate_version.description: Version AFTER the write, so consumers can detect gaps.

envelope_version.description: DEPRECATED alias of schema_version, emitted for one revision so B00 consumer fixtures keep matching. Retire in school-contracts-v4.

schema_version.description: M01's name for the envelope version. Carries the same number as envelope_version, which it replaces in the v4 revision.

correlation_id.description: Correlates every event emitted while handling one request. Null for worker-originated events.
